rules.title: Answer to Complaint
rules.description: Answer must be served within 21 days after service of summons and complaint (FRCP § 12(a)(1)(A)(i))
rules.text: An answer must be served on the opposing party within 21 days after the service of the summons and complaint.

rules.title: Motion to Dismiss
rules.description: Motion to Dismiss must be filed before answer, typically within 21 days of service (FRCP § 12(b))
rules.text: A motion to dismiss may be filed before the answer, typically within 21 days of service of the complaint.

rules.title: Interrogatories
rules.description: Response to interrogatories must be served within 30 days (FRCP § 33(b)(2))
rules.text: Responses to interrogatories must be served within 30 days after being served on the responding party.

rules.title: Requests for Admission
rules.description: Response to requests for admission must be served within 30 days (FRCP § 36(a)(3))
rules.text: Responses to requests for admission must be served within 30 days after being served on the responding party.

rules.title: Deposition Notice
rules.description: Reasonable notice must be given for deposition (typically 14 days minimum)
rules.text: Reasonable notice must be given to the deponent, typically at least 14 days before the deposition.

rules.title: Initial Disclosure
rules.description: Initial disclosures due within 14 days after Rule 26(f) conference (FRCP § 26(a)(1)(C))
rules.text: Initial disclosures must be provided within 14 days after the Rule 26(f) conference.

rules.title: Appeal Deadline
rules.description: Notice of Appeal must be filed within 30 days after entry of judgment (FRAP § 4(a)(1)(A))
rules.text: A notice of appeal must be filed within 30 days after entry of the judgment or order being appealed.
